---
title: "Decision Curve Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(pacman)
dir.create("Results/DCA", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
p_load(tidyverse, dcurves, gtsummary)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
df <- read_csv("Data/merged_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for analysis population (must have FibroScan result to determine outcome)
df_analysis <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(fsm)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age))

print(paste("Analysis N:", nrow(df_analysis)))
```

# Define Outcome and Strategies

Here we define the outcome as **Cirrhosis** (FibroScan $\ge$ 12.5 kPa).
We compare three Age-based strategies:
1.  Treat/Screen if Age > 35
2.  Treat/Screen if Age > 40
3.  Treat/Screen if Age > 45

```{r}
df_dca <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    # Outcome: Cirrhosis (1 = Yes, 0 = No)
    outcome_cirrhosis = if_else(fsm >= 12.5, 1, 0),
    
    # Stratgies (Binary)
    strategy_age35 = if_else(age > 35, 1, 0),
    strategy_age40 = if_else(age > 40, 1, 0),
    strategy_age45 = if_else(age > 45, 1, 0)
  )

# Check event rates
df_dca %>%
  count(outcome_cirrhosis) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```

# Run Decision Curve Analysis

```{r}
# Run DCA
dca_result <- dca(
  formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
  data = df_dca,
  thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
  label = list(
    strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
    strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
    strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
  )
)

dca(
  formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
  data = df_dca,
  thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
  label = list(
    strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
    strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
    strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
  )
) %>%
  standardized_net_benefit()

# Plot
dca_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat All", "Screen All")) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat None", "Screen None")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.01, NA)) + # Zoom in on relevant positive range
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Screen All" = "solid",
      "Screen None" = "dotted",
      "Age > 35" = "solid",
      "Age > 40" = "solid",
      "Age > 45" = "solid"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Screen All" = "black",
      "Screen None" = "black",
      "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
      "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
      "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Decision Curve Analysis: Age-based Strategies for Detecting Cirrhosis",
    x = "Threshold Probability",
    y = "Net Benefit",
    color = "Strategy",
    linetype = "Strategy"
  )

ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_Age_Strategies_Cirrhosis.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


# Inclusion of Non-Invasive Markers (Optional Comparison)

Comparing Age strategies against APRI (>1.0) and FIB-4 (>3.25) if available.

```{r}
# Filter for rows that also have APRI/FIB4 available for fair comparison
df_dca_bio <- df_dca %>%
  filter(!is.na(apri), !is.na(fib4))

if(nrow(df_dca_bio) > 0) {
  
  df_dca_bio <- df_dca_bio %>%
    mutate(
      strategy_apri1 = if_else(apri > 1.0, 1, 0),
      strategy_fib4_3.25 = if_else(fib4 > 3.25, 1, 0)
    )

  dca_bio_ref <- dca(
    formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45 + strategy_apri1 + strategy_fib4_3.25,
    data = df_dca_bio,
    thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
     label = list(
      strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
      strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
      strategy_age45 = "Age > 45",
      strategy_apri1 = "APRI > 1.0",
      strategy_fib4_3.25 = "FIB-4 > 3.25"
    )
  )
  
  dca_bio_ref %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat All", "Screen All")) %>%
    mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat None", "Screen None")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.01, NA)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Screen All" = "solid",
        "Screen None" = "dotted",
        "Age > 35" = "solid",
        "Age > 40" = "solid",
        "Age > 45" = "solid",
        "APRI > 1.0" = "solid",
        "FIB-4 > 3.25" = "solid"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Screen All" = "black",
        "Screen None" = "black",
        "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
        "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
        "Age > 45" = "#7570b3",
         "APRI > 1.0" = "blue",
        "FIB-4 > 3.25" = "red"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Decision Curve Analysis: Age vs Biomarkers",
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )
    
  ggsave("Results/DCA/BayesDCA_Age_Biomarkers.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
} else {
  print("Not enough data with matched APRI/FIB4 for comparison.")
}
```

## Interventions Avoided Plot

```{r}
dca(
  formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
  data = df_dca,
  thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
  label = list(
    strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
    strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
    strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
  ),
  as_probability = c("strategy_age35", "strategy_age40", "strategy_age45")
  ) %>%
  net_intervention_avoided() %>%
  plot(smooth = T) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent)

ggsave("Results/DCA/Net_Interventions_Avoided_Prob.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

dca(
  formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
  data = df_dca,
  thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
  label = list(
    strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
    strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
    strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
  )
  ) %>%
  net_intervention_avoided() %>%
  plot(smooth = T) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent)

ggsave("Results/DCA/Net_Interventions_Avoided.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)


```

# Sub-analysis: Clinically Significant Portal Hypertension (CSPH)

Here we define the outcome as **CSPH** (FibroScan $\ge$ 20 kPa).

```{r}
# Re-create dataset with CSPH outcome
df_dca_csph <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    # Outcome: CSPH (1 = Yes, 0 = No)
    outcome_csph = if_else(fsm > 20, 1, 0),
    
    # Stratgies (Binary)
    strategy_age35 = if_else(age > 35, 1, 0),
    strategy_age40 = if_else(age > 40, 1, 0),
    strategy_age45 = if_else(age > 45, 1, 0)
  )

# Check event rates
df_dca_csph %>%
  count(outcome_csph) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# Run DCA for CSPH
dca_csph_result <- dca(
  formula = outcome_csph ~ strategy_age35 + strategy_age40 + strategy_age45,
  data = df_dca_csph,
  thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
  label = list(
    strategy_age35 = "Age > 35",
    strategy_age40 = "Age > 40",
    strategy_age45 = "Age > 45"
  )
)

# Plot
dca_csph_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat All", "Screen All")) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat None", "Screen None")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.01, NA)) + # Zoom in on relevant positive range
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Screen All" = "solid",
      "Screen None" = "dotted",
      "Age > 35" = "solid",
      "Age > 40" = "solid",
      "Age > 45" = "solid"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Screen All" = "black",
      "Screen None" = "black",
      "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
      "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
      "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Decision Curve Analysis: Age-based Strategies for CSPH (> 20 kPa)",
    x = "Threshold Probability",
    y = "Net Benefit",
    color = "Strategy",
    linetype = "Strategy"
  )

ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_Age_Strategies_CSPH.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
